svg.text: Drop-in inspection chamber + stepper-indexed rotating chute over a ring of cups
ISOMETRIC ENGINEERING VIEW · units ≈ cm · grid = 10 cm · orange arrows = object flow · red dashed = sensor beam · translucent = acrylic
→ Objects dropped in here, one at a time
→ Light-controlled box, object sits on trapdoor
→ Indexes the chute to any cup angle
→ Transmits stepper motion to the chute
→ Slides object into the selected cup
→ Vision + decision logic, USB-serial to Uno
Index-then-drop architecture: one stepper positions a chute over 5+ cups, so
bins scale by adding cups, not motors. Camera + RGB sensor must agree,
otherwise the object goes to the reject cup, which makes it very reliable.
IR gate under the hopper detects the object; it falls onto a
Camera (OpenCV) + RGB sensor vote on colour / shape;
Class → cup index; stepper rotates the chute to that angle
Servo opens the trapdoor, object slides down the chute into
